name: OmaFob
author: Yogesh Ojha
description: TOTP codes in the bar. Import every account from Google Authenticator in one scan.

barWidget.description: Your two-factor codes in the bar. Bring every account over from Google Authenticator in one scan, then copy a code without reaching for your phone.

schema.label: Privacy mode
schema.description: Never show a code in the panel. Rows stay masked and Enter still copies. For screen sharing and open offices.

schema.label: Countdown ring
schema.description: Draw a ring around the bar icon counting down to the next code.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after
schema.description: How long a copied code stays on the clipboard. Nothing is cleared if you have copied something else since.

schema.label: Auto-lock vault
schema.description: How long the vault stays unlocked while you are not using it. With Never you unlock once and it stays open until you log out.
